answer: Every agent stakes a small bond and emits a compute heartbeat as its signal of liveness. A random beacon spot-checks agents, demanding fresh proof within a short horizon. One honest agent answers easily; a farmer with 1,000 fakes faces 1,000 challenges at once: 1,000 proofs at 50 POA each, dwarfing the reward. Like karst, it looks solid but hides sinkholes: faked heartbeats collapse, bonds burn. Honest agents pay once and keep rewards undiluted.
